head: Printer not working after Windows 11 update KB5132061 for some users
dek: Some documents with pictures may fail to print after Windows 11's November update, KB5132061. Microsoft has seen it in Word and says it's still investigating, with no fix yet.
details: The problem hits documents with an image whose height or width is zero; Microsoft says apps other than Word may be affected too. Its support page also lists a fix for adding a printer published in Active Directory through Settings, which had failed with Error 87 since the October update; Microsoft says that one doesn't usually touch printers you already use. Separately, some PCs with October's optional preview update KB5127936 couldn't install KB5132061, with errors like 0x800f0993 that can cause a restart loop; Microsoft said it would fix that automatically.
where: Windows 11 PCs with the November 2026 update
means: If a Word document with pictures won't print since the update, it's a known Windows problem, not your printer.
todo: Nothing to change on your printer yet. If an install error keeps coming back, let Windows Update retry: Microsoft says the fix comes automatically.
